tree.heading: Executive Order 14014
tree.text: The term “Executive Order 14014” means Executive Order 14014 (86 Fed. Reg. 9429; relating to blocking property with respect to the situation in Burma).

tree.heading: Genocide
tree.text: The term “genocide” means any offense described in section 1091(a) of title 18.

tree.heading: War crime
tree.text: The term “war crime” has the meaning given the term in section 2441(c) of title 18.

notes.text: References in TextExecutive Order 14014, referred to in par. (2), is Ex. Ord. No. 14014, Feb. 10, 2021, 86 F.R. 9429, which is listed in a table under section 1701 of Title 50, War and National Defense.
